goat_forehead_spots.cause: Goat_Catch_0 and Goat_Catch_1 were detached emissive highlight spheres (~0.018 diameter, emission 0.35) placed above brow-detected centroids. Goat_Cornea_0 and Goat_Cornea_1 were glassy spheres (originally 0.136 diameter) whose upper hemispheres poked through the brow.
goat_forehead_spots.how_removed: Catch spheres deleted. Cornea objects kept in the file with hide_render=true and hide_viewport=true. Not painted over. Painted in-eye catchlights preserved.

goat_back_marking.cause: Stage-2 Color stamp used a hard-z-cut teardrop widest at a flat top plus a separate vertical tail-base bar at z 0.92-1.16, width 0.065.
goat_back_marking.how_reshaped: Restored original working Color map, then painted a rounded-crown organic teardrop with cosine sides, sine irregularity, soft scarf fade, and no tail bar.

pip_wings.reason: Fused Prism wing verts shredded into vertical shards when lower feathers were translated. Stretch reverted.

pip_eyes.imbalance: fused eyelid opening / generated-face asymmetry, not independent globe scale and not camera perspective alone
